shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json && echo "---MIDDLEWARE---" && find . -name "middleware.*" -not -path "*/node_modules/*" 2>/dev/null && echo "---STRUCTURE---" && find . -maxdepth 3 -not -path "*/node_modules/*" -not -path "*/.git/*" -not -path "*/.next/*" -type d
ls -la app && echo "---" && cat app/*.tsx app/*.ts 2>/dev/null

timeout 30 npm run dev > /tmp/dev.log 2>&1 &
sleep 14
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ > /dev/null
curl -s http://localhost:3000/some/path?q=1 > /dev/null
sleep 1
echo "=== DEV LOG ==="
cat /tmp/dev.log

timeout 30 npm run dev > /tmp/dev2.log 2>&1 &
sleep 14
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ > /dev/null
curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/test?x=2 > /dev/null
sleep 1
echo "=== DEV LOG ==="
cat /tmp/dev2.log
